rv.q: This is a deeply, unapologetically British musical with a quirky, big-hearted charm.
Because after a run of duds, the uneven but captivating Made inDagenham is a WestEnd musical you can be pleased to acknowledge was "made in Britain".
For me, 'Made in Dagenham's mix oflumbering big-heartedness and wild facetiousness worked better than it had any right to do.

With its feel-good approach to a long-won battle for fairness, this show will win plenty of friends out for an evening's easy entertainment.

cn.t: This British musical adaptation of the film earns praise for its heart, humor, and Gemma Arterton's performance, though critics are divided—some find it genuinely affecting and crowd-pleasing, while others dismiss it as plastic and overly sentimental.
